Agent Name: CorporateHistory_IPOs_MondayCom_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In step 2, the agent misidentified both the current C-suite and the IPO-time C-suite by relying on third‑party aggregators (Craft.co and a WSJ “company people” page) instead of monday.com’s official investor relations management page and contemporaneous IPO materials. This led them to list incorrect current C-suite names (e.g., Oren Stern, Amit Mathrani, Michal Aharon) and to assume only three executives were in the C-suite at IPO, producing the wrong comparison and final answer.
